speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the timeline of your symptoms; when did the double vision and weakness first start? Additionally, do you experience any difficulty with swallowing or breathing?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening with activity and improving with rest is very suggestive of myasthenia gravis. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibodies AND REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_nerve_stimulation. Also, can you tell me if you have experienced any drooping of your eyelids or difficulty swallowing food?
